story: An early five-man break featuring Victor Papon, who secured the KOM jersey, was eventually caught. A counter-move from Dewulf, Heiduk and Chamberlain also failed before Slock, Maisonobe and Dhondt sparked the decisive split, with an isolated Pithie unable to respond. Tesfatsion bridged across and outsprinted the group to win on his 27th birthday, with Pithie limiting his losses to retain the pink jersey by just seven seconds.
